lines.text: Can Constitution Hill win at Kempton?
The Floodlit Stakes at Kempton on Wednesday. Oisin Murphy booked.
A Champion Hurdle. Three Christmas Hurdles. Four wins from five at Kempton.
Twice a winner on the Flat this year, then fourth here in September. Can he bounce back?
Can he win? Tell us in the comments! Come on Conny!
What's your favourite Constitution Hill moment?
Cheltenham in twenty twenty-three. Kempton at Christmas, three years running. What a horse.
